honest_note: PROVENANCE SPLIT — read before using. Hop 0->1 and hop 1->2 edges are REAL FlyWire v783 API rows from the general taste-peg GRN class walk (FBbt_00048028; Ir56d-peg E409 neurons are an unmarked SUBSET of this class). The 'anterior_candidate' flags on CB0011 / CB3720 / hyacinth are a LITERATURE-CONSTRAINT (Tauber 2017: peg->anterior SEZ; prow arborization per VFB term descriptions) — a constrained candidate pool, NOT measured Ir56d-peg wiring. Ir56d-peg-subset attribution is UNRESOLVABLE: no API marker distinguishes Ir56d peg GRNs from other peg GRNs. Sweet second-order set (zorro/clavicle/FMIn/fuchs/G2N-1/billiards) does NOT appear in the peg top-k — the peg pool is a different interneuron set — BUT rattle receives sugar-GRN input (Shiu et al. 2022), and both pools converge on SEZ neuron FBbt_00001972 -> identical motor populations (VNC/thoracic/secondary). CB0011 hop-2 is bucket-heavy (system-level classes passed the GENERIC blocklist; documented, same treatment as bitter). Hyacinth API returned FBbt_00001972 twice (tw 2567/1775); deduped to max.
behavior: Taste-peg GRNs (including the Ir56d/E409 fat-taste subset) drive SEZ interneurons converging on the shared SEZ->motor pathway; the anterior (prow) subset is the Ir56d-peg candidate pool.
